newsitem.title: SPAIN: Tabacalera raises Virginia tobacco prices.
newsitem.headline: Tabacalera raises Virginia tobacco prices.

text.p: Leading Spanish Tobacco group Tabacalera said it raised all its Virginia tobacco prices on Saturday, in a delayed response to a summer tax hike.
Prices of Fortuna, Nobel, Diana, Sunset, and Winns brands rose 20 pesetas a pack, the group said.

"The company preferred the correct positioning of its brands in market volume in the medium- to long-term (despite) a short-term loss of margin. Having achieved this objective, Tabacalera has decided to raise prices," the group said.

In a brief statement, the company said the rise would reestablish equilibrium in price differences between its Virginia and black tobacco prices, which were raised at the time of the July 31 tax hike.
